question: per server runtime (workerd, Bun, Node, Hono on Node): package joules and tailscale0 and wlp12s0 bytes per page view, a normal browser view against a spool local view, and a bare HTML request from curl as the floor
instrument: RAPL package-0 energy_uj read on the host; tailscale0 and wlp12s0 byte counters read on the host over ssh; Chromium driven by Playwright on the client Mac, with CDP request and response events (fromServiceWorker, fromCache) per view

software.client: Playwright 1.64.1 on macOS, channel chromium, headless
software.containers: node:24-slim (Node 24), oven/bun:1.4.3-slim (Bun 1.4.3), hono 4.13.13 with @hono/node-server 2.1.5, wrangler 4.151.1 (workerd, local mode)

method.arm order: network, spool, curl, idle, rotated per round
method.network path: Tailscale to paisley-park over DERP relay (see tailscalePath); no emulated latency
method.spool origins: four spool ports, Chromium launched with --unsafely-treat-insecure-origin-as-secure listing them
method.priming: spool: visit / to register the worker, reload, visit each page twice, assert navigator.serviceWorker.controller; network: visit each page twice in the window context
method.check 1 criterion: after priming, 10 spool views make 0 origin requests, and every CDP request in those views has fromServiceWorker true or came from the memory or disk cache
method.check 2 criterion: after priming, 10 network views make 1 origin HTML request and 0 origin asset requests each
method.check 3 criterion: RAPL readable inside the container, and tailscale0 tx moves by at least one curl body
method.counters: package energy (intel-rapl:0 energy_uj, wrap handled with max_energy_range_uj); tailscale0 and wlp12s0 rx and tx bytes; origin counts from each container (requests, html, assets, spool), read on localhost
method.idle subtraction: per round, idle package J per second and idle bytes per second times the window seconds of the same round
method.swAnswered: count of CDP requests with fromServiceWorker true in the window

exclusions: drop any row with a discarded reason (a view error, a failed sample, or 1-minute load above 2.0)
the idle row is the baseline for the same round and runtime; it is not a view
